scope: Five assertions extracted from three ambiguous Penn relationship notes. Assertions describe source wording and do not merge physical identities.

entries.locator: Penn web object 329808; catalogue description; observed 2026-09-05
entries.rationale: Penn explicitly calls B16007 a duplicate of B16081, and the referenced target record exists. The page does not say whether duplicate means the same physical object, a duplicate text, or another catalogue relation. Retain the directed assertion and keep the identities separate.

entries.locator: Penn web object 161879; catalogue description; observed 2026-09-05
entries.rationale: Penn explicitly links B16086 to B16062, and B16062 reciprocally says Same as B16086. The pages do not define the physical or textual scope of Same as. Preserve the reciprocal catalogue evidence without merging the records.

entries.locator: Penn web object 161879; catalogue description; observed 2026-09-05
entries.rationale: Penn explicitly includes B6354 in B16086's Same as note. B6354 is catalogued separately as a sherd associated with a group that includes B16062. The available wording does not establish whether B16086 is a reconstructed whole, a text-level parallel, or a catalogue alias, so no identity merge is made.

entries.locator: Penn web object 287815; catalogue description; observed 2026-09-05
entries.rationale: B16062 supplies reciprocal catalogue evidence for the B16086 relation. Because the page does not define Same as and B16062 is described as a fragmentary object, the assertion remains unresolved rather than becoming a physical-identity decision.

entries.locator: Penn web object 68943; catalogue description; observed 2026-09-05
entries.rationale: Penn describes the B6354 sherd as part of a multi-number fragment group that includes B16062. This supports a physical-part relation between the separately catalogued records, while leaving the exact reconstruction and the B16086 Same as wording for further review.
